page.overview:
What is Littleroot Town?

Littleroot Town is a location introduced in Generation III.

Littleroot Town is a main small town located in the southern area of Hoenn, and is surrounded by a thick forest. This is the player's hometown, where they move into and begin their journey in , , and the remakes . If the player is a boy, their house is on the left, but if they are a girl, their house is on the right. In either case, the second floor of the house is where their room is located. The other house is inhabited by Professor Birch, his child (who is the player's rival), and his wife.

Aside from the two houses, the only other location in Littleroot Town is Professor Birch's Laboratory. Unlike previous games in the Pokémon core series, the player does not receive his or her first Pokémon in the lab. Instead, when Birch is chased by a wild Poochyena (Zigzagoon in Emerald) in Route 101, just outside of Littleroot Town, the player has to select their first partner Pokémon from Birch's bag to battle the wild Pokémon with. After Birch is rescued, the player goes with him into the laboratory, back in Littleroot Town, where he gives them the Hoenn Pokédex. After this, the player's Mom gives them a pair of Running Shoes, though only in the original Generation III games.

Much later, when the player has completed the Hoenn Pokédex in Pokémon Emerald Version (excluding Jirachi and Deoxys), and has obtained the National Pokédex from Professor Birch, he allows them to select one of the starter Pokèmon from Johto: Chikorita, Cyndaquil, or Totodile.
